per_plume.source_hint: Kilauea summit area, trailing south from Hawaii south shore
evidence: USGS HVO at image time: Kilauea ADVISORY/YELLOW in episodic_pause after Episode 55 ended Oct 17 09:03 HST Oct 17, Mauna Loa NORMAL/GREEN not erupting, leaving Kilauea as the plausible vog source. [E1]
No FIRMS fire clusters in plume bbox, while Kilauea summit shows 274 volcanic-thermal pixels, arguing against wildfire_smoke and supporting a volcanic source. [E6]
Mask lies almost entirely over ocean south of Hawaii island (land_frac 0.001) with no island swallowed, indicating a reliable thin over-water veil rather than cloud over land. [E4]

Wind from ENE (77 deg at centroid blowing toward ~257 deg, 68 deg near source blowing toward ~248 deg) vs measured plume drift toward 213 deg SSW at 7.5 km/h with fit R2 0.81; agreement within ~35-44 deg supports southward transport from the island's south shore. [E2, E8, E5]

Upwind end (18.655N, -155.08E) is 86.2 km from Kilauea vs 106.7 km from Mauna Loa; tracked inferred source end (18.87N, -155.285E) is 59.6 km from Kilauea vs 75.3 km from Mauna Loa, favoring Kilauea over Mauna Loa. [E7, E5]

classify.caveats: Kilauea was in episodic_pause ~5 hr after Episode 55 ended Oct 17 09:03 HST; plume is faint and its northern end is partly obscured by heavy cloud over the Big Island, so exact vent connection is inferred from geometry and tracking rather than directly seen.

kilauea.activity_summary: Episode 55 of the ongoing Halemaʻumaʻu eruption ended abruptly at 9:03 a.m. HST on October 17, 2026. VAN is being reissued to drop the alert level from WATCH to ADVISORY and the color code from ORANGE to YELLOW.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts decreased in September compared to August, and minor inflation continues. Mauna Loa had a decrease in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 53 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the September reporting period, after 87 in August. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
